get_products.name: get_products
get_products.description: Get a list of products from Cartloom

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full list of products from the connected Cartloom store. Use to discover available products and their IDs (for example before creating a discount targeting specific products). Takes no input and returns all products; read-only and idempotent.

invoice.description: The invoice ID for the order you want to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single Cartloom order by its invoice ID. Use when you already know the exact invoice ID and want that one order; to find orders without an invoice ID, use the date- or email-based order search instead. Read-only and idempotent.

title.description: Enter the title of the discount

applyOnce.description: Apply the discount once per order

amount.description: Enter the amount of the discount

target.description: Select the target of the discount

startDate.description: The start date of the discount. YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

stopDate.description: The stop date of the discount. YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS

optional.description: ## Optional Settings based on above settings

code.description: Enter the discount code. Leave blank for no code.

domain.description: Your cartloom domain will be the subdomain part of your Cartloom URL. Example: https://mycompany.cartloom.com

apiKey.description: The API key for your Cartloom account

targetPids.description: Select the products to apply the discount to

targetAmount.description: The target amount for the discount when the target is set to Total

targetQuantity.description: The target quantity for the discount when the target is set to All or Products

allowance.description: The number of times the discount can be used

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new discount in the connected Cartloom store, as either a fixed-amount or percentage discount applied to all products, selected products, or the order total. Use to set up a promotion or coupon; supply a code for a redeemable coupon or leave it blank for an automatic discount, and provide start/stop dates. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate discount.

discountId.description: Enter the ID of the discount you want to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the details of a single Cartloom discount by its discount ID. Use when you have a specific discount ID; to list discounts without an ID, use Get All Discounts. Read-only and idempotent.

get_all_discounts.name: get_all_discounts
get_all_discounts.description: Get a list of discounts from Cartloom

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full list of discounts configured in the connected Cartloom store. Use to browse existing discounts or find a discount ID before fetching one specific discount. Takes no input and returns all discounts; read-only and idempotent.

get_orders_by_date.name: get_orders_by_date
get_orders_by_date.description: Get a list of orders from Cartloom within a date range

start.description: Select a date to start the search

end.description: Select a date to end the search. Defaults to today.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all Cartloom orders placed within a date range. Use to retrieve orders for a period when you do not have specific invoice IDs; to narrow results to one customer, use Get Order by Email instead. Requires a start date; the end date defaults to today. Read-only and idempotent.

get_orders_by_email.name: get_orders_by_email
get_orders_by_email.description: Get a list of orders for an email within a date range

start.description: Select a date to start the search

end.description: Select a date to end the search. Defaults to today.

aiMetadata.description: Lists Cartloom orders placed by a specific customer email address within a date range. Use to find a customer's order history; use Get Order by Date to list all orders regardless of customer. Requires the email and a start date; the end date defaults to today. Read-only and idempotent.
